items.statement: Revenue split shifted to 70% API/Evoke and 30% TSP in FY24; management sees 30-70 ratio going forward but big TSP order wins could shift back to 60-40
items.quote: by the time we ended the year, we are seeing that API would contribute about 70% odd and the TSP would contribute about 30% odd.

items.statement: New products launched: Bharat Bill Payment, Online Dispute Resolution, Qynx offline payments, AutoPay, Payout APIs, Cash on UPI; payer solution in POC stage
items.quote: We added two more products including Bharat Bill payment, which has great scope going forward. We not only added that product last year, but we also got to order book. At the same time, we also added online dispute resolution

items.statement: Cash flow will be deployed for hiring leaders and talent, and potentially acquiring/accelerating product development to shorten time-to-market
items.quote: So, these are two very specific areas where the organization will be empowered now. Thanks to this cash flow. So, that's why our decision will be slower in terms of deployment because we have a lot in our hand.

items.statement: Platform scaled to handle about a billion transactions and managing about 20 million customer base
items.quote: how we are scaling our system to do about a billion transactions. That is what our goal was. How do we reach a billion transactions on our platform? And at the same time doing about, you know, managing about 20 millio n odd customer base on this platform

items.statement: Added senior leadership in marketing, HR, and executive director at board level; brought in FinTech veteran Ram Rastogi to board; focus on building second and third line leadership
items.quote: we were able to add senior leadership in marketing and HR and also we were able to add executive director at board level who has tremendous business acumen around domestic as well the global scale. And not only that, I hope you all are aware, we have also strengthened our board by bringing Mr. Ram Rastogi

items.statement: Added VP-level HR and marketing resources last quarter; structuring team around investor relations and financial analysts; ESOP policy with 2% overall budget, 30-40% utilized
items.quote: We added a very senior VP level resource at HR which wasn’t there ea rlier at all. And now the core KRA for the leader is to bring in the second line and third line in the

items.statement: Revenue grew 216% YoY to 130 crore in FY24; EBITDA grew 252% to 43 crore; net profit grew from 6.5 crore to 26.7 crore; EPS from 3.36 to 13.78
items.quote: 41 crore, which was last financial year, I think we did more than that in the last quarter itself, which made about 130 crore the entire financial year '24. Almost 216% growth.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 revenue 44.7 crore (108% YoY), EBITDA 34.2% margin (15.3% YoY growth), net profit 10 crore (160% YoY)
items.value: Revenue 44.7 crore, EBITDA margin 34.2%, PAT 10 crore
items.quote: our quarterly result, which last year our revenue, which was about 21.4 crore has gone up by about 108%, maybe we have got 44.7 crore in revenue. EBITDA, which was about 6.63 crore has gone up by about 15.3% and the overall percentage, which was about 13.9%, has gone to about 34.2%.

items.statement: Razorpay's switch launch strengthens their position but they are not NPST's customer; NPST sits between banks and payment aggregators, sees opportunity to make customers more competitive
items.quote: Now that opens up opportunity for us, whether we have much stronger performing engine, and can I bring such kind of engine where they can now compete with Razorpay.

items.statement: CBDC is top priority in product roadmap; not part of specific RBI pilot programs but preparing switch for CBDC when other banks enter fray
items.quote: CBDC is part of the top priority in our product roadmap where we are looking forward to getting a breakthrough in this opportunity.

items.statement: Global expansion efforts ongoing but no revenue commitment for FY25; substantial value addition expected in two years; currently absorbed in domestic market
items.quote: This year, although we are making all the efforts, we will still not commit any number coming from the global expansion. We are making all the efforts, but two years down the line, we see that it will substantially add value to the organization

items.statement: Key risks: slowing down pace and losing edge; need to continuously increase alliances and relations; concern about missing investment opportunities
items.quote: Our pace, if we slow down, we see that we may lose the edge. That is one big risk. Second is, we have to ensure that we continue to continue to increase our alliances and relations as much as we can in the industry.

items.statement: Evoke API business is volume-based pay-per-transaction model; pricing varies by financial vs non-financial APIs and value-added services
items.quote: Majorly what we are doing is, we are selling a payment platform-as-a-service. So, the model may change from merchant to merchant and client to client.

items.statement: AI/ML investment focused on fraud prediction, risk reduction, and productizing solutions for merchants; not just for scaling but for value addition and global reach
items.quote: is there a pr ediction about fraud? Is there a possibility to reduce the risk associated with the payment business? So, these are challenges that we have come across during our journey

items.statement: Focus on small finance banks and RRBs for TSP business; large banks have long sales cycles, opportunity mainly in new product launches
items.quote: So, our target is simple. What are the new product requirements across banking domains? And if so, what are the entry criteria when it comes to large banks? And what is the entry criteria for the other segments?

items.statement: Organization has good operating cash flow; cash balance expected to grow significantly with 75-100% growth guidance
items.quote: See, there are two areas that is concerning fo r us and that’s why we need cash. One is, how quickly we are scaling

items.statement: 2:1 bonus issue completed; dividend policy not discussed but investor relations function being strengthened
items.quote: Commitment to shareholders was also done with about 2 is to 1 bonus issue.

items.statement: Technical decline rates less than NPCI requirements; further split between switch and core banking shows even lower numbers
items.quote: We are less than the required decline by NTCI. That is very clear. And at the same time, if we further split between our switch and the core banking, the number will further go down
